contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #005: Irrationality of Catalan’s constant.
Audit the literal odd-prime digit and central-layer reductions and prove both full-minor valuation inequalities for n=48N,H=65N,N>=1 and odd primes p with p^2>4H, p<=H, and p-integral G.

contexts.statement: Support-only local denominator theorem for arbitrary 0<=b<=A<L<=H,1<=n<=L-b, odd prime p<=H,p^2>4H, gamma p-integral, arbitrary p-integral P,D supported in [A,H-1],[A+1,H-1], and arbitrary p-integral filters; require p>b in the upper range.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace OddPrimeBound

theorem loss_cap (n R S r s : ℕ)
    (hn : r + s ≤ n) (hr : r ≤ R) (hs : s ≤ S) :
    2 * r + s ≤ min (2 * n) (min (n + R) (2 * R + S)) := by
  apply le_min
  · omega
  · apply le_min <;> omega

theorem pair_loss (n d q k : ℕ) (hk : d - q ≤ k) :
    2 * n - k ≤ 2 * n - (d - q) := by
  omega

theorem retained_count (A b J K : ℤ)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hA : b ≤ A) (hK : K ≤ J) :
    max K 0 + max (J - b) 0 - max (min A K - b) 0 =
      max K 0 + max (K - A) 0 + max (J - max b K) 0 := by
  omega

section Ring

variable {k ι : Type*} [CommRing k] [DecidableEq ι]

theorem central_residue (s t : Finset ι) (V Y a sign : ι → k) (x : k)
    (hx : x = -((∑ l ∈ s, a l * V l) + ∑ l ∈ t, a l * V l))
    (hY : ∀ l ∈ s, Y l = sign l * V l)
    (hSign : ∀ l ∈ s, sign l * sign l = 1) :
    x + (∑ l ∈ s, (sign l * a l) * Y l) = -∑ l ∈ t, a l * V l := by
  have hsum : (∑ l ∈ s, (sign l * a l) * Y l) =
      ∑ l ∈ s, a l * V l := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    rw [hY l hl]
    calc
      (sign l * a l) * (sign l * V l) =
          (sign l * sign l) * (a l * V l) := by ring
      _ = a l * V l := by rw [hSign l hl, one_mul]
  rw [hx, hsum]
  ring

theorem scaled_shear (s : Finset ι) (p x : k) (a Y : ι → k) :
    p * (x + p * ∑ l ∈ s, a l * Y l) =
      p * x + ∑ l ∈ s, a l * (p ^ 2 * Y l) := by
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l hl
  ring

end Ring

section Field

variable {k : Type*} [Field k]

theorem secondary_terms (p y0 y1 y2 : k) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    p * (y0 / p ^ 2 + y1 / p + y2) = y0 / p + y1 + p * y2 := by
  field_simp [hp]
  <;> ring

theorem paired_terms (p a b c d e : k) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    p * ((a / p ^ 2 + b / p + c) + (-a / p ^ 2 + d / p + e)) =
      b + d + p * (c + e) := by
  field_simp [hp]
  <;> ring

end Field

section Determinant

variable {k ι : Type*} [CommRing k] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

theorem weighted_det (p : k) (w : ι → ℕ) (M : Matrix ι ι k) :
    Matrix.det (fun i j => p ^ w j * M i j) =
      p ^ (∑ j, w j) * M.det := by
  rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  exact Matrix.det_mul_row (fun j => p ^ w j) M

theorem det_mem (S : Subring k) (M : Matrix ι ι k)
    (hM : ∀ i j, M i j ∈ S) : M.det ∈ S := by
  let B : Matrix ι ι S := fun i j => ⟨M i j, hM i j⟩
  have hdet : (B.det : k) = M.det := by
    simpa [B] using (S.subtype.map_det B)
  rw [← hdet]
  exact (B.det).property

theorem scaled_det_mem (S : Subring k) (p : k) (w : ι → ℕ)
    (M : Matrix ι ι k) (hM : ∀ i j, p ^ w j * M i j ∈ S) :
    p ^ (∑ j, w j) * M.det ∈ S := by
  have h := det_mem S (fun i j => p ^ w j * M i j) hM
  rwa [weighted_det] at h

theorem bounded_denominator (S : Subring k) (p : k) (hp : p ∈ S)
    (w : ι → ℕ) (M : Matrix ι ι k) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : (∑ j, w j) ≤ D) (hM : ∀ i j, p ^ w j * M i j ∈ S) :
    p ^ D * M.det ∈ S := by
  have h := S.mul_mem (S.pow_mem hp (D - ∑ j, w j))
    (scaled_det_mem S p w M hM)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hD] at h
  exact h

end Determinant

end OddPrimeBound

claims.natural_statement: For every 0<=i,j<H, the rationally defined M0 and Z0 satisfy both digit reductions eq:digit-layers with the locally integral sides and the boundary convention M0(-1,j)=kplus(j+1). The starting reductions, complete-block identity, carry analysis, and reduced-index integrality are derived from the exact recurrences, not assumed.

In the upper range H/2<p<=H,p>b, every central column j>=J with b<=j<min(p,L) has pF_j integral and pF_j=-sum_{ell<J} V_ell/(j-ell) modulo p; all coefficients are units or integral as required, by the direct recurrence proof in report.md Section 5.

The support-only universal theorem of report.md holds: every full raw minor and every p-integral filtered determinant obeys v_p(Delta)>=-2n+(d0-q)_+ in the lower range, and v_p(Delta)>=-min(2n,n+R,2R+S) in the upper range, with d0,R,S exactly as defined there. This includes every positive-N manuscript specialization, all boundary cases, and arbitrary p-integral gamma, without assuming the disputed digit or central congruences.
Literal main theorem thm:main in introduction.tex: Catalan constant G is irrational. This claim remains unaudited beyond the bounded arithmetic node.
The three fixed 48-by-48 matrices in nonvanishing.tex have the asserted nonzero determinants and justify the prime-scale reduction; this remains an open audit obligation.
Proposition prop:first-sheet-bound of real-place.tex gives its case-conditioned uniform interpolation estimate; not audited in this mission.
Proposition prop:second-sheet-bound of real-place.tex gives its uniform second-sheet estimate; not audited in this mission.
Proposition prop:energy-reduction of energy.tex correctly converts admissible trial sequences into the real-place energy estimate; not audited in this mission.
The rational barrier certificate supplies admissible trials with the two claimed case bounds in certificate.tex; not audited in this mission.
